2607.09892.title: Next-Dense-Stride Prediction for Multimodal Autoregressive Visual Modeling
2607.09892.paper_summary: We introduce DenseAR, a new generative paradigm that reformulates autoregressive image generation as coarse-to-fine next-dense-stride prediction using a compact single-scale tokenizer. Our key insight is that traversing a single-scale latent grid with progressively denser strides naturally captures the transition from global structure to fine detail. This addresses two limitations of existing autoregressive models at once: the slow inference of raster-order autoregression, which DenseAR avoids by predicting multiple tokens in parallel, and the heavy cost of multi-scale approaches, which need long, multi-resolution token sequences to achieve coarse-to-fine prediction. Building on our efficient framework and the flexibility of autoregressive modeling, we further extend DenseAR to a unified model that handles multiple modalities and imaging tasks within a single backbone. We validate DenseAR on both medical and natural images. On multi-contrast brain MRI, a single DenseAR model unifies cross-modal translation, modality-conditioned generation, and tumor segmentation, while remaining competitive with task-specific methods. On ImageNet, DenseAR improves class-conditional generation quality (FID and IS) over both a single-grid baseline without stride ordering and a multi-scale tokenizer-based baseline.
2607.09892.paper_summary_zh: 我們介紹了 DenseAR，一種新的生成範式，將自回歸圖像生成重新定義為使用緊湊的單尺度標記器進行粗到細的下一個密集步幅預測。<lb/>我們的關鍵見解是，通過逐漸增密的步幅遍歷單尺度潛在網格，自然捕捉到從全局結構到細節的過渡。<lb/>這同時解決了現有自回歸模型的兩個限制：光柵順序自回歸的慢推理，DenseAR 通過並行預測多個標記來避免這一問題，以及多尺度方法的高成本，這些方法需要長的多解析度標記序列來實現粗到細的預測。<lb/>基於我們高效的框架和自回歸建模的靈活性，我們進一步擴展了 DenseAR，形成一個統一模型，能夠在單一骨幹中處理多種模態和成像任務。<lb/>我們在醫學和自然圖像上驗證了 DenseAR。在多對比腦 MRI 上，單一的 DenseAR 模型統一了跨模態翻譯、模態條件生成和腫瘤分割，同時在與特定任務的方法相比時保持競爭力。在 ImageNet 上，DenseAR 提高了類條件生成質量（FID 和 IS），超過了沒有步幅排序的單網格基線和基於多尺度標記器的基線。
